answer_1.quote: Numerical QA (Question Answering) is one representative group of such number-dependent NLP tasks. E.g., Math Word Problem Solving, Discrete Reasoning, Tabular Question Answering. These Numerical QA tasks require NLP systems to arrive at a numerical answer from the numbers in the question and context.
answer_1.outputs: numerical answers or logical forms (equations) that lead to numerical results

answer_2.quote: The metric we report is 1) the metric on original datasets (Original), and 2) the absolute change of the metric on perturbed datasets, denoted by '∆'.
